## R Markdown

## Data Set Background

This data was collected by the Washington Post, and is collected information about homicides in large cities. The data set includes information about arrests, locations, etc of each crime included in the data set.

## Data Source
https://github.com/washingtonpost/data-homicides/tree/master 

The above link connects to the github site where the data set was originally downloaded from.
